title: Canonical derived pullback of a class with pulled-back source
statement: Let B,T,T' be schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], h:T→B, a:T'→T and s:T'→B with s=a≫h. Let M be an abelian etale sheaf on B [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], K a bounded-below derived object on T [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], q any integer and z:single(h^*M)→K[q]. Define the class on T' as single(upperStarComp(a,h,s).hom_M), followed by the inverse exact-inverse-image single comparison, then D+(a^*).map z, then the shift comparison. This is a map single(s^*M)→D+(a^*)K[q]. No data are selected from existence. The chart pullback is the free-source pullback-square comparison followed by this construction.

proof.text: Form the four displayed canonical maps. Their source and target match by the single and shift comparisons. The definition is exactly their composite; the chart pullback precomposes it with the original free-source comparison. No data are chosen from existence.
